input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production; merge when done.

doc_friction.issue: cloud-session pyenv advice: `python3 platform/ci/pyenv.py pytest numpy` printed /usr/bin/python3.13 (which has numpy) but bare `python3` lacks it, so develop_engine_check.py failed with a misleading 'needs numpy and an image at least 2x2' until I used python3.13 explicitly.
Start-here pick was chant-forge, which 11 sessions in 2 days left; its buildable items are narrow synthetic tuning rounds. I took photo-editing's BUILDABLE item instead.

deviations.why: allocate picked chant-forge (row 7); the brief asks for revenue-oriented depth and photo-editing has the highest revenue cap (40) among flagships with a concrete buildable quality defect
deviations.did: took photo-editing's buildable item: interpolate the 4,096-entry tone table
deviations.result: shipped; 16-bit masters reach 45k-65k levels, LibRaw p99 gap down 3-4x on two cameras

notes: run_venture_tests.py photo-editing: ok (1304 tests, 9 skipped, 209 s). tests/test_srgb_table.py 3 passed with numpy. develop_engine_check --half: Pentax QS1 and Nexus 5X identical bytes across engines. dng_camera_check vs rawpy 0.28.0 old/new p99 8-bit: Leica T 0.136/0.035, Pentax 0.160/0.047, Nexus 1.198/1.152.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an imaging engineer finding, fixing and measuring a LUT quantisation defect across two engines with LibRaw cross-check

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
